jobs.title: Consulting Operations Manager - Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Position:** Consulting Operations Manager \| Technical Project Manager

**Location:** United States – Remote, Chicago, IL area preferred (1\-day in office per week)

**Employment Type:** Full Time or Contract\-to\-Hire

**Who this role is for:** You turn signed consulting agreements into well\-scoped, properly staffed, accurately billed engagements. You combine project control, capacity planning, financial rigor, cybersecurity literacy, and client judgment \- and work independently to protect delivery quality, scope, and margin.

**What You'll Do**

* Own cybersecurity consulting engagements from internal handoff through scheduling, delivery, billing, and closeout.
* Translate statements of work into project schedules, consultant assignments, milestones, dependencies, and billing triggers.
* Coordinate capacity across a small billable team, balancing client commitments, consultant skills, utilization, and deadlines.
* Maintain Excel\-based project and financial controls using formulas, structured tables, lookups, WORKDAY, SUMIFS, and related functions.
* Administer milestone billing and contract mechanics, including deliverable\-based invoice dates, payment schedules, scope reductions, credits, and billing reconciliation.
* Lead client communication, resolve delivery or billing disagreements, and maintain a clear, fact\-based position when necessary.
* Identify scope creep, quantify its effect, and convert out\-of\-scope requests into approved change orders before work proceeds.
* Oversee testing, findings, reporting, and retesting workflows; improve operational tools and handoffs while protecting sensitive client and financial information.

**What You Bring**

* Experience managing projects or operations in a professional services, consulting, or other billable environment.
* Advanced Excel capability, including formulas, structured tables, lookups, WORKDAY, SUMIFS, date logic, and reconciliation \- not simply data entry or workbook maintenance.
* Working knowledge of milestone billing, contract mechanics, deliverable\-based invoicing, scope reductions, and change orders.
* Experience coordinating schedules and capacity for a small team of specialized professionals.
* Strong client\-facing written and verbal communication, with the judgment to manage disputes constructively and defend a well\-supported position.
* Cybersecurity literacy covering common offensive or defensive assessment types, findings, evidence, remediation, and severity ratings.
* Demonstrated self\-direction, problem solving, scope discipline, and discretion with sensitive vulnerability, client, pricing, and margin information.

**Strong Pluses**

* Experience with PSA, CRM, or sales\-pipeline platforms such as Autotask, ConnectWise, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or HubSpot.
* Experience with work\-management and Microsoft 365 tools, including Planner, Jira, Asana, Monday.com, SharePoint, Lists, Teams, and Outlook.
* Experience administering PlexTrac or a comparable security reporting platform.

**Nice to Have**

* Subcontractor coordination experience.
* PMP certification or an equivalent project\-management credential.

**Why Join HALOCK**

At HALOCK, consulting operations is not an administrative function. It directly influences delivery quality, consultant effectiveness, billing accuracy, margin, and client trust. You will work with experienced security consultants and business leaders in a high\-trust environment where you are expected to surface risks early, challenge unclear assumptions, and improve how work gets delivered.

**What you can expect:** Remote\-first work, meaningful ownership, varied cybersecurity engagements, experienced teammates, and room to improve the systems behind client delivery.

**About Us**

HALOCK Security Labs is a full\-service information security consulting firm in Schaumburg, Illinois. Since 1996, we have provided technical security expertise and strategic advisement across penetration testing, red teaming, malware defense, incident response, risk, and compliance.

HALOCK offers competitive compensation and benefits, including bonus potential, paid training and certifications, health and dental coverage, 401(k), long\-term disability, conference attendance, and more.

**Ready to apply?** Send your resume and a brief note describing a complex consulting engagement you coordinated, how you controlled scope and billing, and how you handled a difficult client or scheduling issue.

**Disclosures**

* HALOCK is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
* Full background checks are performed, with consent, on all successful candidates before employment offers can be extended.
* US citizens and Green Card holders, EAD and TN are encouraged to apply. **We are unable to sponsor H\-1B candidates at this time**.
* No third parties, please. Only individuals need apply.

Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $125,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Retirement plan

Work Location: Remote

This position is located in **Gaithersburg, MD; Egg Harbor Township, NJ; or Eagan, MN**. This is an opportunity to contribute to projects that impact millions of air travelers.

**This is a hybrid position requiring 3 days onsite and 2 days remote work. Candidates should reside a commutable distance to one of the above locations.**

* Own workforce planning and organizational design for the ART including team structure, headcount allocation, and skill mix optimization

* **An active Secret security clearance at the time of application.**

The position is based at a Government facility in **Moffett Field, California**. **Role Description:**



Arcadis is seeking an experienced, collaborative, and client\-focused Certified Project Manager 1 to join our Project and Program Management team in San Francisco, California. This full\-time position will be responsible for overall strategy and financial performance of assigned remediation projects, with senior\-level leadership across contractor, stakeholder, regulatory, health and safety, and financial management. The ideal candidate will bring strong project management experience, commercial acumen, effective communication and team leadership skills, and the ability to lead teams while maintaining a focus on safety, quality, financial performance, and client satisfaction. In this role, you will manage project scope, schedule, budget, risk, and resources to successfully deliver project objectives in alignment with Arcadis standards, client expectations, and contractual requirements. This position will report to our San Francisco, California office and offers flexibility through hybrid work arrangements.



**Role Accountabilities**



This position will include both project delivery and client\-facing responsibilities. The successful candidate should be comfortable managing multiple priorities, working with multidisciplinary teams, engaging with clients and stakeholders, and supporting projects that may involve complex technical, contractual, regulatory, and business requirements.


* Develop and execute project plans, schedules, budgets, and delivery strategies to achieve successful project outcomes.
* Manage project scope, schedule, budget, financial performance, and risk throughout the project lifecycle.
* Ensure compliance with client contracts, subconsultant agreements, and project\-specific requirements.
* Build strong client relationships by delivering technical solutions, addressing client needs, and identifying new opportunities.
* Promote Health \& Safety, including conducting periodic field visits to verify safe work practices, contractor compliance, and quality of project execution.


**Qualifications and Experience**



Required:


* Bachelor of Science in Geology, Engineering, or closely related field
* 10 years of relevant experience, including experience managing and leading teams


**Preferred qualifications:**


* 4\+ years of project management and/or task management experience.
* Arcadis project management certification or active progression toward certification.
* Proficiency with Arcadis project management systems, project management tools, and Microsoft 365 applications.


 **Location and Travel Requirements:**


* Candidate must reside within the San Francisco Bay Area.
* Approximately 20% travel is required to support project activities.
* Travel includes visits to remediation project sites, contractor operations, stakeholder meetings, and local office locations.
* Field visits are necessary to provide health and safety leadership, verify project execution quality, support stakeholder engagement, and mentor project personnel.
